Key points:  
- As "AI coworker" forms like Claude Cowork, Hermes, and Perplexity Computer continue to emerge, OpenClaw is also evolving. Its arrival marks a paradigm shift in AI agent roles, where intelligence begins to possess execution capabilities.  
- Qualcomm Technologies, leveraging its unique positioning, is driving the era of AI agents, enabling intelligent, personalized, and intuitive experiences that operate seamlessly across the intelligent edge (between devices).  
- Our platform is designed for running agent planning on lightweight devices with exceptional energy efficiency.

OpenClaw sends me a news briefing every morning, plans healthy walking routes, reminds me of weather-appropriate attire, and provides real-time updates on the logistics progress of the audio system I ordered from Japan. As a pioneering leader in the AI heavy truck sector, Zaihe Truck has secured support from top venture capital firms including BV Baidu Ventures, Suzhou Venture Capital, and Lushi Investment.
